notes.title: Spiritstead DEMO is Live on Steam
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that the Spiritstead Demo has launched and is now LIVE on Steam! [/p][p][/p][p]Step into a magical world, build your town with the help of wandering spirits, and experience the cozy beginnings of your adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]We’d love to see the towns you create, feel free to share them with us in our Discord channel [url="https://discord.gg/7N98WgTewm"]https://discord.gg/7N98WgTewm[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Spiritstead DEMO Launching September 23rd!
notes.content: [p]We’re excited to announce that the Spiritstead Demo will be available to play on September 23rd right here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Step into a magical world, build your town with the help of wandering spirits, and experience the cozy beginnings of your adventure.[/p]
